statements.reason: China at 40% of last year's sales is the company's own disclosed exposure; it supports the revenue/policy judgment rather than locating the answer.

statements.section: §4.3（罢工不开题，是证据）; §5.1 第2类; §6.2 辅助
statements.reason: A strike authorisation vote is a dated action by the airline's labour supplier; authorisation is not yet a strike and carries no amount, so 辅助.

statements.reject_row: 只有形容的引语，哪怕是具名的人说的
statements.reason: 'Demand is very strong' from the CEO has no number, period or reason.
A regulator preparing a ~$1bn fine is a regulatory step with an amount material to a bank; 'preparing' is not determined but the amount satisfies §6.2; unnamed sources make it 传闻.

statements.section: §5.1 第1类; §6.2 核心（关键判断：利润，确定状态）
statements.reason: The chief actuary's statement that Q3 catastrophe losses were the highest in a decade is the company's own determined result on its main profit driver; no amount but the state is determined.

statements.section: §6.3 第2步（只关乎市场预期）; §6.2 可选
statements.reason: A broker downgrade is a market-expectation item; its stated reason (falling copper) carries no number, so the sentence stays 可选.
15 of the Fortune 100 as customers is the company's own adoption number without revenue, so 辅助.

statements.section: §5.1 第4类; §6.2 核心（政策决定，确定，带比例和期间）
statements.reason: Extension of a 25% steel tariff through 2027 is an official decision with rate and period that sets the steelmaker's pricing environment.

statements.section: §5.1 第1类; §6.2 核心（关键产品，带比例，已发生）
statements.reason: New efficacy data (hospital stays cut by a third) presented by the company is a determined, quantified result on the value-bearing product's adoption case.

questions.reason: §3.1 A admits a cost item when it is the debate ('航空公司的燃油成本常常是'); FY2026 is the current year, fuel CASM is reported in the annual report, it changes the airline's profit, and no question is open.

A bill phasing out Chinese-made lidar does not name a revenue, profit, cash or competitive line of NVIDIA or any covered company that it changes; §4.2 test 1 says effects only on uncovered companies do not count.

FY2028 is NVIDIA's next fiscal year for a July 2026 item (§3.1 A '今年或明年', B17), so the period passes; A says a total-revenue question is rewritten as the segment that carries almost all the business (data-center) and then opened; no FY2028 question is open.

questions.not_open_row: 同一个量的另一个估计、另一种口径、另一个来源
questions.reason: Total revenue is rewritten to the data-center question (§3.1 A), which the case says is already open; SemiAnalysis's view is another estimate of the same quantity and becomes evidence on it.

For a regulated utility the rate base is the annual quantity that carries its value (earnings follow it); 2027 is next calendar year, it is reported in the annual report, and the 8% guidance gives the midpoint.
A regulator's decision to fine one bank is a regulatory process that decides only this company (§3.1 E → 标的); ~$1bn changes its profit, the official decision checks it, and no question is open.

A tariff governs many parties (theme); it changes the steelmaker's pricing, is checkable against the official tariff schedule on the date, and is not a duplicate; the extension already decided it, so the current judgment sits in the 'in force' rung.

questions.not_open_row: 客户的部署或采购计划
questions.reason: Revenue from one named customer is not a reported line that an annual report settles, and §4.3 makes a customer's purchasing decision evidence for the company's own revenue question rather than a question.

questions.not_open_row: 同一个量的另一个估计、另一种口径、另一个来源
questions.reason: China's share of sales is a geographic cut of the company's revenue (another 口径 of the A-class quantity), not a quantity whose answer moves the business independently of total revenue; the 40% disclosure is evidence.

questions.not_open_row: 不属于 §3 五类的事件，哪怕会影响仓位：罢工、事故、召回、诉讼结果、进不进某个行业指南、某个奖项
questions.reason: A strike is named in the closed not-open list; the authorisation vote is evidence for the airline's A-class questions.
Copper price is a price outside any one company that several move on (§3.1 D); 2027 is next calendar year; it changes the miner's revenue and is settled by published price data.

questions.not_open_row: 不属于 §3 五类的事件，哪怕会影响仓位：罢工、事故、召回、诉讼结果、进不进某个行业指南、某个奖项
questions.reason: Guideline inclusion is named in the closed not-open list; the conference data (Z12) is evidence for the drug's revenue question.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 (rows for 股价涨跌, 重述, 新加坡) vs §6.2 可选 / §6.5
ambiguities.readings: §5.3 lists these under 不留 yet its boundary and §6.2 say 可选 ('留下不算错，不留不算漏'); the keep boolean has no third value. Reading 1 (used here): keep=true, weight=optional. Reading 2: keep=false with the §5.3 row quoted. Two readers will split on every optional item.

ambiguities.sections: §6.2 可选 (待拍3) vs §6.3 step 2 vs §5.3 第一层 vs §1 七类驱动
ambiguities.readings: §6.3 routes only market-expectation items to 可选, so ecosystem numbers/awards have no step in the three-step procedure; and none of the seven drivers covers them. Reading 1: optional as the draft says. Reading 2: reject at layer 1 (touches no driver). Driver field cannot be filled either way.

ambiguities.sections: §5.1 (标题和正文是同一条) vs §5.3 closed list
ambiguities.readings: A headline is 'not a separate record' but §5.3 has no row for it, so reject_row cannot be quoted. Reading 1: keep=false, cite §5.1. Reading 2: keep=true as the same record as S40.

ambiguities.sections: §5.6 一件事一条 vs per-sentence classification
ambiguities.readings: When a sentence is a term or fragment of a kept event, §5.6 says it belongs to one record. Reading 1: the fragment inherits the record's keep and weight (U04 core, T30 kept). Reading 2: judged alone it is a detail with no amount and may fall under 产品参数/形容引语 (S16, S42 rejected here). The standard does not say which.

ambiguities.sections: §5.1 四类 ('谁在说谁' vs '具名一方')
ambiguities.readings: Unnamed sources reporting the company's own action: kind 1 (content is the company's own decision) or kind 3 (anyone's claim about the company, but kind 3 says 具名). Neither row fits an anonymous source about the covered company.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 '拒绝置评'本身 and its boundary
ambiguities.readings: The sentence carries both the decline (not kept) and the report it refers to (evidence, usually rumour). Reading 1 (used): keep as the rumour. Reading 2: reject the sentence by the row and expect the report elsewhere.

ambiguities.sections: §6.2 核心 ('金额或确定状态') vs §6.2 辅助 ('缺金额，或只是在谈'; '一次不大的借款') vs §6.2 '确定不确定看说法本身'
ambiguities.readings: Status is 'aims to'/'preparing' (not determined) but an amount exists, sourced only to unnamed people. Reading 1 (used): amount alone satisfies core and reliability goes to tier. Reading 2: intent plus rumoured amount is 辅助. The 'or' in the core definition and the 'in talks' example in 辅助 pull apart.

ambiguities.sections: §5.5 ('媒体照实报道的' = 事实 vs exception '只有某个分析师或研究机构这么说（它自己查到、没有公开的）')
ambiguities.readings: 'X reported that [company status]' is fact if the outlet relays a public announcement and third-party view if it is the outlet's own finding; the sentence does not say which and the reader cannot know. U34's 'the report' may even be the company's own pitch document (party statement).

ambiguities.sections: §5.5 ('推出了一个计划' = 事实 vs '宣布了将来要做的事' = 当事人陈述)
ambiguities.readings: 'Agreed to explore' is an agreement that exists (fact) whose content is a future exploration (party statement). Both §5.5 sentences apply.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 rows 2 and 3
ambiguities.readings: The P/E sentence does not name the company; if NVIDIA it is 可选, if Microsoft it is 别家公司的估值 and 不收. The standard assumes the reader knows the subject.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 '记者或作者的背景和框架' vs §5.1 第3类 '说出理由的具体判断'
ambiguities.readings: A bylined journalist's reasoned interpretation: is a byline '具名一方'? Reading 1: only outside parties (analysts, executives, experts) count, so author reasoning is background. Reading 2: a reasoned judgment with a stated reason is kind 3 whoever writes it. S01 and T16 kept, S21/U06/U36 rejected here on that line, but another reader could flip all five.

ambiguities.sections: §4.3 '高管任免 → 证据或不留'; §5.1 第1类 decision list
ambiguities.readings: The not-open row leaves both outcomes ('证据或不留'), and the kind-1 decision list (pricing, capacity, investment, financing, product dates, plans, partners, suppliers) does not name hiring. Reading 1 (used): a top sales hire is evidence (辅助), the pay package is layer 1. Reading 2: all three are 不留.

ambiguities.sections: §1 七类驱动 vs §5.1 第1类
ambiguities.readings: The company's own results and metrics (revenue, margin, FCF, losses, impairments, customer counts) are kind 1 but none of the seven drivers is 'the company's own P&L'; the driver field is forced onto a neighbouring driver. The standard says drivers explain 'why a statement matters' but gives no slot for the main-driver quantity itself.

ambiguities.sections: §6.1 step 1 ('关键判断' vs '一般驱动') and §6.2 ('别家公司自己的经营数字只是间接指标')
ambiguities.readings: Whether an event is 'the key judgment' or 'a general driver supporting it' has no closed set: a rival's approval, industry shipments, an impairment, catastrophe losses, trial data can each be read as core (determined, touches revenue/profit) or 辅助 (one layer removed). Y04 is also 'another company's own event' by the 辅助 sentence.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 第一层 vs §5.1 第3类 vs §5.3 '碰到四类之一就不是这一条'
ambiguities.readings: A named engineer's industry estimate with a number matches kind 3 literally; layer 1 rejects it for touching no NVIDIA driver. The 'check the four kinds first' rule is stated for layer 2 only, so it is unclear whether layer 1 can override a literal kind-3 match.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 新加坡转运案件 (可选) vs §5.1 第4类
ambiguities.readings: The sentence is on a Singapore-case page but describes a separate US government probe of a customer's chip use. Reading 1 (used): a policy step, 辅助. Reading 2: part of the Singapore case overview, 可选.

ambiguities.sections: §3.1 A ('提出的是总收入，就改写成那个分部的问题再开'); §3.3; B17
ambiguities.readings: The proposed question is total revenue; the standard says rewrite to the segment and open. Is the answer 'open: true' (the rewritten question opens) or 'open: false' (the proposal as worded does not)? Also whether the rewrite is a 续期 of FY2027 data-center revenue if that were open.

ambiguities.sections: §3.1 E ('一个政策或监管过程到了哪一步'); §4.2; §4.3
ambiguities.readings: The tariff is already extended through 2027: no process is pending, yet all four tests pass literally. Reading 1 (used): open as E theme with the current judgment in the 'in force' rung. Reading 2: nothing is in motion, the extension is a kind-4 fact and the question is not worth tracking. §4.3 has no row for 'already decided'.

ambiguities.sections: §3.1 E vs §4.3 '例行诉讼程序' and '诉讼结果 not in five classes'
ambiguities.readings: A regulatory fine is an official decision about one company (E, asset) or a legal outcome outside the five classes. The standard's E examples are approvals and licences, not enforcement.

ambiguities.sections: §3.1 A ('不是每一行报表数'; segment examples only) vs §4.3 '同一种口径'
ambiguities.readings: China share of sales: a geographic cut of revenue (evidence) or, for an equipment maker, the debated quantity itself (A). §3.1 names segments, not regions.

ambiguities.sections: §3.1 A ('承载公司价值的那个年度量'; '常常是')
ambiguities.readings: Which quantity carries a utility's or airline's value is left to the reader's industry knowledge ('常常是'); a reader unfamiliar with regulated utilities could reject rate base as 'not a revenue line'.

Whether NVIDIA's automotive platform exposure makes a lidar bill a covered-company effect is unknowable from the standard; a reader counting automotive partners as NVIDIA demand would open it as E theme.

ambiguities.sections: §5.1 第2类 ('客户、供应商、竞争者、伙伴')
ambiguities.readings: A labour union is none of the four named counterparties; kind 2 is forced by treating labour as a supplier. Kind 3 (a party's claim) does not fit an action.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 '只有形容的引语' vs §5.1 第1类/第3类 ('CFO 说十年前建的工厂仍满负荷')
ambiguities.readings: A CEO's 'demand is very strong' is adjectives only, yet the kind-3 example keeps a qualitative management statement with a specific fact; the line between 'specific judgment' and 'description' is not drawn.

ambiguities.sections: §6.2 核心 example '公司宣布为云客户产能兜底的新计划（确定状态，没给金额也是核心）'
ambiguities.readings: The example makes the announced plan core, but B23 is only SemiAnalysis's claim that guarantees have started: weight rule says source does not affect weight, so core; another reader applies 辅助 for a third-party claim without amount.
